ai_review.summary: Studio‑quality soundboard recording of an immaculate 1971 show where every song shines with crystal‑clear balance.
ai_review.review: The reviewer hails the mix as “hot hot hot,” noting flawless clarity, perfect vocal placement and a bass that never distorts—a true studio‑level capture for a live 1971 performance. Musically, the band is described as playing all songs very well, delivering an all‑time keeper with relaxed pacing and no rushed moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Both show performance and recording quality are praised at the highest level; a single detailed review yields strong but limited evidence, so confidence is medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix described as hot, accurate, with total clarity and balance; bass guitar highlighted for lack of distortion; no audible issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Relaxed pacing with long gaps between song tune‑ups, creating a smooth, unhurried flow.
